::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Saturday Evening Oct 21st 1865  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 113
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
My London plans have dwindled down to the smallest span - i.e. - to running up for a day with my [sister in law](people/person_1604.qmd) on Wednesday the 25th. I hope to call at 16 Bedford St[^1] somewhere between 12 and ½ past 4.

Would you send me a line to say whether I shall find you, and if one time is more convenient than another. Please write by Mondays post as I shall have to start before the letters came[sic] on Wednesday.

My present address is at [Mrs Dyson](people/person_462.qmd)’s, Church-Crookham, Farnham.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

I should prefer the earliest hour

---

[^1]: The address of Macmillan & Co.’s office.
